summary: Pre-market read: the composite risk score is unchanged at 41.05, still in the caution band, and the regime remains goldilocks. Overnight was quietly risk-friendly — the 10Y yield eased to 4.7% from 4.75%, the 10Y real rate to 2.43% from 2.47%, VIX to 15.86 from 15.99, and HY OAS tightened to 2.78 from 2.85 — while Asian tech tracked Wall Street's AI rally, with SoftBank up 13%. The tension sits between a macro dimension at 76.4, the highest of the six, and liquidity and credit at 17.84, the lowest: rates are the pressure point, financing conditions are not. Cross-asset confirmation of only 0.1667 remains the largest single contributor to the score, so the advance is still poorly corroborated across asset classes. Watch the open for whether single-name air pockets — AMD indicated down 8% despite an earnings beat — spread into the broader AI complex.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Cross-asset confirmation reads just 0.1667, the largest single contributor to the composite: equities, credit and crypto are not corroborating each other, so the rally rests on a narrow, unconfirmed base.
The 10Y real rate of 2.43% sits at the 99.05th percentile of its history — the top macro risk contributor and the main channel through which any inflation surprise would hit valuations.
A nominal 10Y yield of 4.7% at the 98.25th percentile keeps the macro dimension at 76.4, the highest score of any dimension, despite coverage of only 0.75.

VIX at 15.86 leaves the volatility dimension at 29.13; compressed implied volatility means positioning carries little cushion if the pre-market wobble in AI hardware turns into a session-long de-rating.
AMD is indicated down 8% pre-market despite beating expectations, carrying a news importance score of 52.46 — a 'good news sold' reaction that flags stretched positioning in AI semis.

supporting_signals.claim: Leadership is thinning: only 0.25 of the tracked universe is making new highs even though 0.875 sits above its 200-day average — strength is broad but not deepening.
Semiconductor relative strength of 9.9202 concentrates the index advance in a single complex — exactly the group facing pre-market pressure.
Price sits 9.971% above its 200-day average with a 52-week drawdown of 0.0 — the market is extended and holds no discount to absorb a shock.

contradicting_signals.claim: Credit is the strongest argument against the caution reading: HY OAS at 2.78 (18.22nd percentile) and IG OAS at 0.78 (17.09th percentile) hold the liquidity and credit dimension at 17.84, the lowest of the six.
Three-month momentum of 7.4261% with a new-lows ratio of 0.0 shows no internal deterioration; nothing is breaking under the surface.
The curve is positively sloped at 0.45, so the classic recession signal is absent and the macro score is driven by the level of rates rather than their shape.

what_changed_today: The composite is unchanged at 41.05 with a 1-day trend of 0.0 — the headline number did not move, the mix beneath it did.
Yields eased across the curve overnight: 10Y to 4.7% from 4.75%, 2Y to 4.25% from 4.28%, leaving the spread at 0.45 versus 0.47 prior.
The real rate fell to 2.43% from 2.47% and the breakeven to 2.23% from 2.27%, so the move was priced through lower inflation compensation rather than weaker growth.
Credit tightened and volatility slipped: HY OAS to 2.78 from 2.85, IG OAS to 0.78 from 0.79, VIX to 15.86 from 15.99.
Oil round-tripped on geopolitics — an early bid on a claimed Houthi strike on a Saudi tanker faded once Washington signalled a Strait of Hormuz deal could land within days.
Beijing announced countermeasures against a set of US actions, adding a policy overhang to China-exposed supply chains.
watch_next: Whether AMD's 8% pre-market decline despite a beat spreads to the wider AI semis complex, which carries a relative-strength reading of 9.9202.
The 10Y real rate at 2.43%: with the 99.05th percentile already reached, any renewed rise lands directly on the highest-weighted risk contributor.
Cross-asset confirmation at 0.1667 — a move toward agreement would validate the advance; further divergence would mark it as a false breakout.
Whether the Strait of Hormuz headline converts into a signed agreement; oil is the swing factor for the inflation leg of the macro dimension.
The fact layer carries no scheduled events for the next seven days, so headline risk rather than data risk dominates the session.

bull_case.title: Bull: goldilocks persists as rates ease and credit stays tight
points: Credit spreads sit near cycle lows — HY OAS 2.78 and IG OAS 0.78 — so financing conditions stay supportive of risk assets.
Overnight rate relief with the 10Y at 4.7% and the 2Y at 4.25%, alongside VIX at 15.86, gives equities room to extend.
Breadth of 0.875 above the 200-day with a new-lows ratio of 0.0 shows the advance is not yet narrow at the index level.

base_case.title: Base: caution holds with the score anchored near 41.05
points: The composite stays in the caution band as macro at 76.4 is offset by liquidity and credit at 17.84.
Index-level strength coexists with single-name air pockets in AI hardware: dispersion rises, direction does not.

bear_case.title: Bear: the rates pin snaps and the cross-asset divergence resolves lower
points: The 10Y real rate at the 99.05th percentile (2.43%) is one hot inflation print away from re-tightening financial conditions.
Cross-asset confirmation of 0.1667 with price 9.971% above the 200-day leaves the market both extended and uncorroborated.
A new-highs ratio of 0.25 shows leadership already thinning; an unwind in AI semis would remove the main engine of the advance.
